english: Seemingly out of the air itself, a masked figure appears.
Master- bad vibe <shake>behind</shake>!
The intimidating shadow stands ready to strike with dagger in hand.
A coward's weapon for a creature who prefers a sideways fight.
Alone.
Time... shortening.
Fray... <shake>near</shake>.
You should not have-
Wait- wait...!
(Use your super-fast reaction speed to react super-fast.)
(Just stand there.)
Yeah. Try asking him nicely.
That'll do great. Just-
Yes!
But the assassin moves faster.
No!
What are you DOING?!
Acceptance.
There is no... fixing this.
How dishonorable.
You cannot just backstab someone like this!
That's not-
<shake>YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE COME HERE ALONE</shake>.
(Get stabbed by a shadowy hex-blade.)
...this maybe one of your friends, Cleric? the goblin manages to ask, before his eyes widen.
A stranger is just a friend you haven't made yet! Ask about their exercise routine.
Ah, shit.
Not this again...
I also do not like this situation.
(Point at the assassin.) "That's an assassin."
(Just get ready to fight.)
His eyes fall on the dagger and he immediately reaches for his sling.
Oh! It's happening, <shake>let's gooo...</shake>!
Roll initiative.
You can hear precise, controlled breathing from beyond their esoteric mask.
This is it. They are ready to kill.
You spring into motion, prepared to act.
Your goblin companion takes the initiative.
The Masked One holds up the dagger, quicker than you are able to react.
Or, at least, this time. You're fast as fuck, just, you know, can't win 'em all.
Snell whips his sling with practiced flair, and launches a stone.
The assassin flips backwards trying to dodge it, but it connects nonetheless with a sickening sound.
The sound of a brittle-branch-breaking.
The masked figure's head tilts at you suddenly.
A flick of the wrist, a quick motion with the hands, and dark energy surrounds you.
But only in your mind...
A Hex!
You will take constant damage from this - typical warlock spell.
You feel a deep unease permeate your bones just as the assassin hurls a blast of sickly energy.
But you are close enough to see him preparing the blast, and you duck. It arcs over you harmlessly.
It lands squarely in your chest, causing an eruption of pain.
The uneasy feeling turns to a sensation of needles stabbing into you.
<shake>...Rrngh</shake>.
Needles... more like needless! Heh... hate needles.
The assassin intends to use the distance between you to their advantage.
Focus.
Throw something at him! Anything!
Look, you obviously have to get closer.
Make your choice now. This is either a mental or a physical fight. Don't try to go in two directions at once.
Cleric- there's a... Hex!
You know about Hex, Snell?
Throw something at the attacker.
Steel yourself against this threat.
Close the gap.
Yell something surprising.
Maybe you can't see it- but there's little shadow-worms crawling all over you!
Anyway- FOCUS! Get the bastard!
You pick up the first thing you can grab and hurl it with all your might.
(Grab a handful of...)
It is a clod of dungeon dirt... and moss!
It speeds through the air and explodes on the assassin's chest.
Hell yeah! This is your turf!
The Masked One looks down at the dirt, seemingly checking for injuries.
They are surprised when they find none - but they do seem rattled by the experience.
But it breaks apart almost instantly and the particles fall down all around you. Damn!
You breathe deeply, centering yourself before the assassin attacks.
You breathe deeply, centering yourself after seeing what the assassin is capable of.
The breath comes easily, fluidly, and deeply, filling your body with calm.
You are prepared for struggle.
You close your eyes and try to breathe deeply, but the panic of the situation gets to you.
Opening your eyes back up, you find yourself no calmer or more prepared than a few moments before.
<shake>Rrngh</shake>.
Wow, doing nothing didn't do anything? What a surprise!
You run towards the Masked One, using all your energy to get closer.
The assassin tumbles backwards quickly, but not quickly enough. You're in striking distance!
This'll make the fight a lot easier.
If you want to resolve it physically, yes.
You run towards the Masked One, using all your energy to-
You stumble and smash your head on the ground.
You groan in pain and stand back up.
If you're gonna run full-on like that, you have to stretch first.
You grope for something that will disrupt his rhythm.
And you find it.
There's no escape! We have you surrounded!
The assassin jerks to attention and glances over both shoulders.
Heh. You can see he believes you, and he's distracted by the possibility.
You are a good liar.
And you... well, you'll have to give it a shot.
Surprise!
The assassin does not react even one iota.
Not very fun, huh? He could at least play along, do a little fake "oh wow!" before he stabs you or whatever.
You have such horrible ideas all the time.
What is an iota?
You charge dark energy into your fist with smooth ease, sprint forward, and jab directly at the assassin.
You put the bad juice in your hand and punch.
Your fist connects with his shoulder, and the necrotic energy surges through his body.
A grunt of pain escapes from the composed assassin.
With a flamboyant flip, he's now out of reach once more.
You charge dark energy into your fist and throw a wild haymaker at your foe.
The assassin doesn't even have to dodge; you were much too far away.
Embarrassing.
Frankly, that was one of the most embarrassing things you've ever done. But you don't have time to dwell on that.
You raise a palm, rub your fingers together, and open your hand, summoning a torrent of grease.
It sprays all over the assassin and the surrounding area.
Get greased, idiot!
A strategic choice.
Time to get all slippy slidey.
Playtime's over.
You will not allow some filthy sneak to kill you.
You are in danger.
Cleric! You've been Hexed! yells the goblin, whirling another stone.
Ah, yes. Of course.
The stone misses the Masked One. They glance sharply at Snell.
The Masked One again lifts their hand, shooting a viridescent blast.
You endure the pain as best you can.
Then, the uneasy feeling sharpens and slices at your nerves.
The assassin appears frustrated at having lost their dagger. They are searching for it.
You need to get up close. And personal.
You're close enough to act.
That's enough. That's perfect.
What're you going to do?
Punch!
Disarm him!
Consider the nature of the magic.
You cannot beat the classics.
You wind up your fist, and connect mightily with the Masked One's mask.
He stumbles back and clutches at his face for a moment.
That provided no protection. It isn't armor in the traditional sense at all.
It really is just to hide their identity.
You throw a punch, but it doesn't have enough force behind it. It's sluggish.
The assassin easily dodges you.
You take a step forward and, using both hands, quickly push his wrist one way and the flat of the dagger the other.
The dagger pops out of his hand and lands on the ground a few steps away.
You catch him gasp with more panic than you'd expected.
That dagger is critically important to them. An heirloom? No, it's tied to their very being... it's a hexblade!
You take a step forward and clumsily swipe at the assassin's dagger.
The Masked One adjusts his wrist slightly, and you grab the blade itself.
You take a moment to consider what sort of foe you face.
It's typically hard to think during the heat of combat, but the conclusion is clear: this is a warlock.
You've been Hexed, and you are being attacked with Eldritch Blasts.
Which means that dagger is a hexblade. Their hexblade.
Okay, so... this is a dagger-wielding mage...
And...
You cannot figure it out.
You look at the already-injured assassin as you again charge energy into your fist.
Throwing a powerful uppercut, you catch the underside of The Masked One's mask.
Excellent. He is very badly hurt.
The assassin ducks easily under it as the energy dissipates.
You again spray grease all over the assassin.
He continues to be greasy.
Get greased, idiot.
All three of you are beginning to tire.
Beginning to tire... much like a bicycle being used for the first time!
Eh, this one won't be interested in jokes. Nevermind.
The end is near.
As the assassin squirms in your grip, Snell runs over and gets a hold of the Masked One's legs.
The both of you have a secure hold on your enemy, but this assassin continues to thrash with surprising vigor.
Oh, no. Are they too strong and powerful to be retained by your grip? Ohhhh...
Snell sprints forward at the assassin and tries to slide-tackle his legs.
The assassin leaps into the air to dodge...
But Snell reaches a hand up and connects with the Masked One's ankle.
The assassin tumbles to the side, almost falling prone.
Yes! That's your Snell, baby!
What a sidekick.
The assassin raises his off-hand as though he's going to blast you with energy again...
But he lashes out with the dagger instead.
It slices into your forearm, cutting a ragged gash in your flesh.
Again, the pain of the hex asserts its stinging grasp.
The Masked One scrambles to find the blade on the ground.
It takes the assassin a few precious seconds to find it.
End this fight. Now.
You can disrupt that magic blade's String. You have the capability.
You can mess up the way that dagger works.
That mask would be valuable to have. And knowing who's trying to kill you is usually a good idea.
Grapple!
Disrupt the esoteric String of the dagger.
Grab the mask.
No more games.
You move in on the tumbling, dodging assassin. You thrust your palm forward and grab the assassin's arm.
He squirms and thrashes, which gives you an angle on the other arm.
You maneuver yourself and squeeze with every struggle, every panic. You are a python.
You constrict.
You move in on the assassin, getting a palm on his forearm.
But your grip is weak. The assassin shakes you off and steps back.
Damn.
You raise both hands in front of you and curl your fingers.
You reach out- not physically, but esoterically.
And you connect with the String connecting the assassin to the dagger.
The String of a warlock and his Hexblade.
You shear the String, and the blade snaps with the release of the esoteric tension.
It flies from the ground into the assassin's side, cutting deeply, then clatters back to the rock.
You shear the String, and watch as the dagger is set free in a rapid spinning motion.
It cuts into him deeply. A painful murmuring escapes the mask.
The assassin releases a shaky breath.
You reach out esoterically and pluck at the String that attaches the assassin to the dagger.
You try to shear the String, but its strength resists you. It bounces towards you, away, and back, striking you sharply.
You feint low, then reach out suddenly with both hands and connect with the mask.
You give it a yank, and it peels away from the assassin's face. It tumbles to the ground.
<shake>No</shake>!
You see the assassin's face for a moment.
The... huh. His face? Her face.
You're just a...?
Why are you doing this?!
...Hey, what the hells?
She scowls. And says...
<shake>Fuck you</shake>.
Then, in an instant, the mask is returned onto her face, like a materializing mist.
What?
You are being attacked by a young lady?!
This poor child.
You feint low, then reach out suddenly with both hands and swipe at the assassin's face.
He leans back casually and your hands clap together.
Shit!
This hasn't gone the way the assassin expected.
They probably thought they were going to kill you.
They probably thought you were going to give them a big reward.
Your muscles burn.
The goblin has risen from his slide-tackle and tries to get a hold of the assassin.
He is struggling to secure a grab, but the assassin is harried and focused on preventing it.
The assassin puts both hands on his dagger.
Clearly attempting to... do something.
Clearly attempting to channel some sort of energy into it.
But he finds he can't.
In a rage, he slashes at you with the dagger.
The assassin puts both hands on his dagger and channels a swirl of pale green energy into it.
He slashes at you with the blade, connecting with your torso.
A horrific pain follows, striking you even DEEPER than the very REAL physical damage.
Then... the HEX once again PAINS you.
You can finish this slog of a fight right now.
You're exhausted.
Convince him this is a stalemate.
Punch. Punch. Punch!
You exhale angrily, like you're only just controlling your rage.
Enough! It's over!
The assassin watches you warily, then mutters something.
You exhale shakily. You are tired.
Enough, please. I don't want to fight you anymore.
Coward.
What?!
Alright. Nobody disrespects you like that. It's time to wreck this sucker!
You have to prove yourself. You are pathetic too often. It's time!
Wait, maybe take your time-
(Sprint at the assassin.)
Alright. You start to run at the assassin.
The Masked One steps towards you and plunges his dagger into your belly.
<shake>UGH...</shake>
Shit...!
That voice seems to want to ask the question, '<shake>why won't you die...</shake>?'
You wind up, throwing your remaining strength into one punch. It connects.
The assassin crumples, dead-weight, to the ground.
Finally!
But something escapes the pipe. A spell?
The Masked One is suddenly moving again!
You wind up, throwing your remaining strength into one punch. You miss.
Damn, damn, damn.
Hold the grapple!
The Masked One struggles mightily, but cannot break free.
The assassin starts thrashing back and forth with a steady rhythm.
Your arms ache.
What are you doing?
Suddenly, the Masked One changes the rhythm of the rocking and twists in your hold, breaking free.
You hear a crunching sound from the assassin's mouth, and suddenly, he shrinks to a tenth of his size.
You hear a crunching sound from the assassin's mouth, and suddenly, she shrinks to a tenth of her size.
Bastard bit down on something?
A Reduce spell.
The- the pipe! He's going for the pipe!
The- the pipe! She's going for the pipe!
You reach, but... your body fails you.
The tiny, little assassin... hops into the pipe.
(Stare in shock.)
The Masked One takes a step back.
Your companion takes a step back.
(Take a step back.)
Good idea.
Exhaustion weighs on all of you like a heavy blanket. Snell holds up his claws - palms facing the attacker.
You want a nice, cozy blanket. That'd be nice...
You calmed down? We all cool here?
He is breathing HEAVY.
Stay. Away.
That voice. Is this a young boy?
That voice. Yeah, this is absolutely some teenage girl. Wow.
The assassin turns and runs - the cloak fading into a misty invisibility.
(Let yourself breathe again.)
The air fills your lungs.
The effort you've exerted... is catching up to you.
You wobble.
The world begins to fall away.
You hear Snell's voice. It is concerned, quiet. Distant, and yet close.
Whoa there, Snell mutters, an elbow pressed against your side. "Not yet. Not in the City Below."
You feel disappointment.
Fear for the future.
General confusion, really.
Look.
Snell points towards the stairs behind you.
They go down. Far down.
But the assassin... got away. (Feel pain as you breathe.)
Just let me... sleep for a little bit. (Feel dozy.)
We won, Snell. Huzzah...! (Almost die.)
Yeah, yeah.
No, no.
Oh, gods- no, no.
The goblin doesn't look too good himself as he returns the sling to his back pouch.
I- look. We can either head back upstairs. Or we can continue down.
But whatever that bastard didn't want us to see down there... we now have an open path.
You're right, Snell. We should keep going.
You're right, Snell. We should go rest first.
Well, that's not really-
I meant: we can go take a rest. Then come back here later. The dungeon ain't gonna shift right away. But...
Look- whatever you think is best.
You take the lead. I'll be right behind. Okay?
The mystery of this strange assassin continues.
You have a distinct feeling you will have to face that mask again. And the one behind it.
Revenge. That is what fuels you now.
You WILL find him down there. You will reprimand this bastard.
You WILL find her down there. You will reprimand this girl.
Hm. A woman is hunting you. A young one at that.
A hag perhaps? No. That would be far too expedient. All the clues point towards a very simple answer.
You are dealing with a renegade warlock. And you are heading straight towards her master's lair.
From all the magic you have seen here, the clues point towards a very simple answer.
Not a hag. Nor some brutish mercenary paid for your blood. No. That would be far too expedient.
You are dealing with a renegade warlock. And you are heading straight towards his master's lair.
Whatever's hiding down these stairs is most likely - like, actually probably - exactly what that assassin doesn't want you to find. So...
Time to get going!
Time for TRUTH to be unveiled.
Once your body stops leaking...
E-Count your blessings from Urth.
